rationale: The position has failed to sustain the momentum required to reclaim the VWAP ($935.48) and is currently trading below both the VWAP and the 9-EMA ($933.53). With the broader market (SPY) showing weakness and the stock struggling to hold the $931 level despite high relative volume, the original thesis of a base-building retest is invalidated by the recent series of lower highs and the inability to hold support.
